entities.name: Otagi Nenbutsu-ji Temple
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Otagi Nenbutsu-ji is a Buddhist temple located in the hillside of the Arashiyama neighborhood of Kyoto, Japan. It is known for the 1,200 moss-covered arhat statues that cover the hillside around the temple grounds.
